notes: RTCA, Inc. is a US private, not-for-profit association that develops consensus-based technical guidance for aviation, published as DO-series documents and adopted by the FAA through Technical Standard Orders and Advisory Circulars. EUROCAE is its European counterpart; most DO documents have a paired ED document with equivalent content. Documents are paywalled.
